result: Recovered 104 candidate product IDs from the supplied inventory capture and cross-checked three public starter IDs. Full game catalog and complete item-grant support remain unresolved.
requested_target: Every item on the private local account, with original server-side item instances and equipment state.

assets_reviewed.reason: Directory exposes two entry names, ChrDefaultSphere.NSX and GEMFIGHTER.NST; decoded payload types and contents are unverified, and no server configuration has been identified. ZIP-like compression and encryption flags require format-specific interpretation. The old Watto fixed extra offset differs from these local headers; its Basic plugin has no active decompression exporter. Bounded raw-deflate probes of the first entry did not validate; no assets were extracted or decrypted.
Does not match the published Watto NSZ!/NSZj header or bounded directory offset. Filename alone does not establish contents or server-setting purpose. No extraction or decryption performed.

nsz_zip_like_details.standard_zip_flag_interpretation: Bit0 encrypted and bit3 data descriptor are set. This supports an encrypted ZIP-like payload hypothesis, not proof of the exact NSZ cipher/password.
nsz_zip_like_details.published_plugin_limit: The locally inspected GameExtractor NSZ plugin has no active decompression exporter and uses a fixed142 extra offset; supplied archives declare122 local extra bytes. NSZj plugin only implements bounded filename XOR, not payload decoding.
nsz_zip_like_details.reason_no_extractor: Container metadata is grounded; payload decryption and decoding are not. No password guessing or brute force was performed.

capture_evidence.input: User supplied original startup capture, already reassembled server-to-client stream
capture_evidence.inspection: Only inventory/equipment response bodies were decrypted in memory by the new analyzer; unrelated bodies advanced through the cipher using synthetic zero bytes.
capture_evidence.final_page_warning: Count44 controls validity despite55 nonzero capacity records; unused record capacity must not be interpreted as extra items.
capture_evidence.persisted_fields: Deduplicated product IDs, aggregate unknown-field distributions, public starter names, structural booleans and source hashes only. No owner, instance, avatar, credential, session or raw-record data.

starter_fixture_evidence.source_semantics: CreateAccount inserts the selected class, fishing rod and class-specific default Exo with END=1000, then creates10 avatars using the class item instance as JobServerID and Exo item instance as ExoID.
starter_fixture_evidence.unknown_fields: Meaning of integer+8 and opaque17-byte region+12..28 remains unknown. In these3 records+12..22 is zero and+23..28 contains nonzero opaque data; these opaque values were not persisted.
starter_fixture_evidence.proposed_original_candidate: Use local instances1=class,2=Exo,3=rod; observed nonidentifying unknown integer words at+8; END1000; stat0; synthetic zero fill for all remaining fields. Ten invented avatars1..10 each use Job1 and ExoA2, equipped avatar1. This does not replay a captured record.
starter_fixture_evidence.candidate_limit: The real client has not yet validated the populated starter serializer or zeroing the unknown17-byte region. It provides three starter items, not every item.

pagination.conclusion: No grounded cursor/page model recovered. Do not emit all104 IDs as if one80-slot response can contain them or repeat a guessed next-page response.

remaining_work: Locate the actual NSZ resource decode/read routines or a matching validated decoder to recover the full catalog and names/categories.
Validate a small original three-item starter response and coherent avatar/equipment fixture on the exact client.
Recover pagination/filter semantics and item duration/flags before larger grants.
Add persistent local item ownership and equipment mutation after wire acceptance.

upload_guidance.reason: All3 selected resource files match downloaded patch-manifest size and CRC32, so re-uploading them would not fix the unknown decoding format.
